schemas.BestOfSequence: Result of one of the additional best-of generation sequences.

schemas.ChatCompletionChunk: A streamed chunk of a chat completion.

schemas.Details: Details of a token generation, returned when requested.

schemas.Function: Function invocation produced by the model.

schemas.MessageChunk: A chunk of message content, either text or an image URL.
